children: Episode 1 Is Available Now on the GoPro Snow YouTube Channel, with New Episodes EveryWednesday Through Nov. 25
SAN MATEO, Calif., Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, GoPro, Inc. (
) premiered "

," a six-part original series following professional skier, BASE jumper and GoPro Athlete Matthias "Super Frenchie" Giraud on his two-year mission to ski BASE jump from the north face of the Aiguille du Plan, a line that hangs over Chamonix in the French Alps.

On May 26, 2026, Giraud skied the 600-meter, 50-degree face, made two 60-meter rappels anchored in ice and finished with a ski BASE jump, skiing off the bottom serac and opening his parachute midair. First skied in 1977, the face has been descended only a handful of times. According to Giraud, no one had ever exited the line with a ski BASE jump.

Episode 1, "Becoming Super Frenchie," revisits Giraud's 2011 jump above Megève, where he skied off a cliff, triggered an avalanche and opened his parachute as it poured over the edge behind him; the helmet-cam clip became one of

. The episode then follows his 2013 crash and three-day coma, his return to complete the same jump six years later and a series of ski BASE firsts in the Mont Blanc massif that set up the Aiguille du Plan.

"That 2011 jump changed my life," said Giraud. "After my accident, I had to rebuild everything, mentally more than technically. I learned that conditions are what they are, not what you want them to be. I'm 43 now, and it feels like everything before was training for this. I'm so excited to share my line on the Aiguille du Plan with the world."

"Few athletes have pushed GoPro cameras further than Matthias has over the past 16 years," said Rick Loughery, Senior Vice President of Global Marketing & Digital Commerce at GoPro. "'The Line Above' captures all of it, from setbacks to summits, and shows what it really takes to stand on top of a line like the Aiguille du Plan."
Availability

" is a GoPro and Thule production, directed by Stefan Laude of Fresh Films and written by Laude and Giraud, with footage from GoPro cameras ranging from the original HD HERO to the current lineup, including HERO13 Black, MAX2 and the new MISSION 1 PRO. Episode 1 is available now on the GoPro Snow YouTube channel, with new episodes every Wednesday through Nov. 25.

"The Line Above" is the latest series from GoPro Snow, following last winter's "Off the Record," which went behind the scenes of the 2026 Freeride World Tour season. GoPro, the tour's official camera, will partner with Freeride World Tour by Peak Performance on a new series coming soon.
Subscribe to GoPro Snow on YouTube and Instagram, and follow Matthias Giraud on Instagram to catch each new episode.
